artifacts.prompt_direction: Match the existing mission objective icons: a glowing white radar sweep, contact blips and a circular patrol arrow on rich teal glass, thin gold beveled rounded-square border, transparent exterior, no words. Readable at 53 pixels.

artifacts.prompt: Create a production game UI asset: a circular portrait of deep space for a space strategy game's mission destination, replacing a planet portrait. Exactly one centered perfect circular window of luminous indigo and teal nebula clouds, distant pinpoint stars and dark interstellar space, cinematic realistic painted sci-fi style. No planets, no ships, no UI border, no lettering, no symbols. The circle should fill the square canvas and all pixels outside the circle must be truly transparent. The image will be shown at 104 to 160 pixels square next to a label Deep space, so use broad readable nebula shapes with restrained light. Square canvas 1024x1024. This will be saved as assets/images/mission/deep space.png.

Create a new square PATROL objective hover illustration for the Stellarion space strategy game. This is a full painted scene, shown at 150x150 pixels, NOT an icon, badge, radar symbol, logo, UI graphic or framed button. Images 1 and 2 are STYLE references: match the existing Spy and Protect objective cover illustrations' classic early-2000s sci-fi strategy-game digital painting, slightly soft and textured brushwork, muted dark metal, dramatic localized engine glow, atmospheric starfield and luminous blue-grey nebular haze. Images 3 and 4 are SHIP IDENTITY references. Preserve image 3's long dark industrial Cruiser with its blocky forward hull, exposed mechanical spine and teal details, and image 4's compact silver Light Fighter with its pointed orange cockpit and swept angular wings. Scene: this recognizable Cruiser and three small matching fighter escorts are patrolling quiet open interstellar space in a loose searching formation. One cruiser dominates the foreground in a readable three-quarter view; escorts are separated around it at different depths. Convey vigilant watch and exploratory movement, with a faint faraway ship silhouette near the distant stars. Restrained warm engines against cool blue-black space, strong simple composition that reads at a small thumbnail size. No nearby planet or planetary attack, no combat beams or explosions, no radar rings or holographic overlays, no arrows, no text, no letters, no numbers, no border or watermark. Opaque square full-bleed painted background. This will be saved as assets/images/mission/patrol cover.png.
